raw_resume.summary: QA Engineer with 2+ years of professional experience in embedded systems and firmware testing. Seeking a Software Engineer II role at Google Cloud, with hands-on expertise in Python, C++, and test automation for distributed embedded devices.

bullets: Tested BLE pairing and GATT services across 12 Android and iOS devices for a wearable product line.
Automated 150 firmware regression cases with Python and pytest, reducing regression cycle from 3 days to 1 day.
Logged and triaged defects in JIRA with firmware developers during 2-week sprints.

projects.name: ESP32 BLE Sensor Logger
projects.description: Personal project during career break: C firmware on ESP32 with FreeRTOS that advertises temperature readings over BLE and logs them to flash.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with JavaScript or Java to match the JD's core language requirements; your Python foundation will transfer quickly.

Build or contribute to a project involving large-scale system design or distributed computing (e.g., microservices, message queues, or cloud APIs) to demonstrate readiness for the Software Engineer II level.
Lead or participate in formal code reviews in your next role and document the feedback process; this is a key responsibility for the role.
raw_resume.growth_note: Your QA and embedded background is strong but orthogonal to the Software Engineer II role, which emphasizes product development, system design, and distributed systems. You have only 2 of 10 curated keywords and lack the core languages (JavaScript, Java) and system-design experience the JD prioritises. Consider gaining 1-2 years of software development experience (not QA) in a cloud or backend context before applying.
